###### our process

### What to expect with Redbud VC

Built from thousands of founder conversations, our process is simple and flexible.

Pitch Us

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/eQ1aQTaAMegrqvU66t2q9OFyw.png?width=800&height=800)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MIPfJLsB8diNjfs8T7d0DTDX6c.png?width=1456&height=816)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/MnY6CuPeoR6DAnwlyXDsJs75YDM.svg?width=24&height=24)

#### Timeline

Our process takes 1-3 weeks, but we can expedite when needed.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/aJslxb0EG61veF629EJFtOw24Fk.svg?width=24&height=24)

#### Calls

Expect to have 2-4 calls with our team

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/eQ1aQTaAMegrqvU66t2q9OFyw.png?width=800&height=800)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0yC2Rh4UIDNDTnQBolAisEcTDng.png?width=1456&height=816)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/13IE79Fsx8gJYCIDjAfHDZ2I8.svg?width=24&height=24)

#### Diligence

Request ~2 customer intros or referrals while we leverage our network of operators

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/7Woc6dRyg7NruRqurUMGiBAjw8.svg?width=24&height=24)

#### Final Steps

Final call with partners and issue a termsheet within 24 hours. No investment committee.

Unique approach

# The Story of Redbud

Built from our experience raising capital, wishing we had investors like Redbud VC

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/maABUSp2fYhWvD1LieM7rygnWQ.png?width=990&height=990)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tgVEdF6ITENMD271WcrvjZ8.png?width=1456&height=816)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bEtstOloqKOHNir9zYjygCjapA.png?width=450&height=450)

#### Missouri Roots. Our Work is National.

Redbud started in Columbia, Missouri, because it’s our home. We back founders who reflect the same qualities we were built on: grit, humility, and first principles. Our roots keep us scrappy. Our network keeps us competitive. Our results speak for themselves. We’re building a lasting venture brand from the center of the country outward and we’re just getting started.

Operator DNA

We're company builders who've scaled from zero to thousands of employees and customers, generating billions in revenue—often under the radar. That background shapes how we pick founders, how we support them, and why we often win the first check into the scrappiest companies.

Strengthened by Struggle

We don't chase pedigrees—we look for resilience. Coming from unconventional backgrounds ourselves, we appreciate struggle and spot value early that others miss. That's why over half of our deals start with us, and why top-tier investors follow our lead.

Why Columbia, MO?

Columbia has produced an outsized number of breakout companies for a city its size—Zapier, EquipmentShare, Carfax, Paytient, and others—generating billions in value. Many of those operators stayed, creating a dense network of capital and experience. That's our home base.
